text.en: Most dog owners praise Jeremiah for transforming reactive, anxious, or disobedient dogs into calm and manageable companions. Clients report being able to take previously aggressive dogs on public walks and to outdoor cafes without stress. Although one owner felt the board and train format did not suit their dog's needs, the general outcome is very successful.

Reviewers commend head trainer Jeremiah for his patience, deep knowledge of canine psychology, and positive reinforcement techniques. Clients appreciate that he takes time to coach pet owners so they can maintain consistent habits at home. Pet parents highlight his persistent dedication, especially when working through complex behavioral difficulties.

Clients consistently observe that dogs receive abundant affection, structured exercise, and thoughtful care during their boarding residency. Owners of timid rescues note that training helped their pets gain confidence and flourish. While one client noted collar chafing on sensitive skin, reviewers generally describe an environment filled with genuine love for dogs.

q.en: What training methods are used during board and train?

a.en: Training emphasizes positive reinforcement, clear boundaries, reward-based motivation, and handler consistency.

q.en: Does the trainer coach owners after boarding concludes?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight dedicated handover sessions where Jeremiah teaches owners how to maintain progress at home.

q.en: Can the program help dogs with fear or dog reactivity?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report significant improvements in reactive and fearful dogs, enabling peaceful neighborhood walks.

q.en: How long are typical residential training courses?

a.en: Clients commonly enrol their dogs in three-week or four-week board and train programs tailored to behavioral goals.
